atoms.text: I do volunteer work because I want to help others. I have many things that I am grateful for, which is why I want to give something back. I know that some people are less fortunate than me. Some can't buy new clothes and toys and others can't even buy a warm meal. That is why I regularly help out at soup kitchens on weekends. I try to help by spending my time and energy for this cause. I hope that I have a positive impact on people's lives by doing that. I am thankful for this opportunity.

atoms.a: He volunteers at soup kitchens on weekends.

He donates his pocket money for this cause.
He is grateful for the things he has, therefore he is thankful for the opportunity to give something back.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>to connect</voice> bedeutet Kontakt herstellen <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>beach cleaning</voice> bedeutet Strandsäuberung.

atoms.text: I do volunteer work because I want to meet new people. I always see the same people at school and in my extracurricular activities. And I really love all of my friends that I made in class and at my gymnastics club. However, I want to meet people from different backgrounds and ages, that have different views on certain topics. Also, I want to connect with people who care about the same issues as I do. Therefore, I volunteer at beach cleaning events. It is a really easy and fun way of meeting new people. I've already made new friends who I now see outside of these clean-up events, too.
